references.text: The first of the firstfruits of your land you shall bring to the house of the Lord your God. Both texts concern the firstfruits that are to be given to the Lord.
You shall give him the firstfruits of your grain, your new wine, and your oil. This verse mentions the same three products: grain, new wine, and oil as firstfruits for the priests.
Instructions on taking the firstfruits of all the fruit of the land and bringing them to the chosen place of the Lord.
The Israelites gave generously from the firstfruits of grain, new wine, oil, and honey. Shows practical fulfillment of the commandment regarding firstfruits.
The people committed themselves to bring the firstfruits of their flour, their offerings, fruit from all trees, new wine, and oil to the priests.
An exhortation to honor the Lord with your wealth and with the firstfruits of all your produce. A thematic parallel on giving the best to God.
The first of all the firstfruits and every kind of offering shall belong to the priests. Ezekiel confirms the principle of firstfruits for the priests.
